# .mdeck

> Plain text in, slides out. .mdeck turns markdown-ish text into a clean slide deck that opens in the browser, with the whole deck carried inside the link (after the #), so nothing is uploaded and no account is needed.

Read SKILL.md and follow it to make slide decks for people as .mdeck links.

- [SKILL.md](https://mdecks.yolopreneur.lol/SKILL.md): how to write a deck and build its link
- [Editor](https://mdecks.yolopreneur.lol/): the page a deck link opens in
